app.name: Kola Hub
app.title: Kola Hub
home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Kola Hub {version} · Works offline
home.firstRunTitle: Tools for your files, with no sign-up.
home.firstRunBody: Kola Hub helps you clean messy CSV tables step by step and saves a clean copy beside your original. It works completely offline on this computer.
home.firstRunFolderBody: Open any folder on this computer. Your original files are never changed, and nothing is hidden or locked away.
home.firstRunOfflineBody: Nothing leaves this computer. There is no account, no cloud and no tracking.
home.summaryEmpty: Open a folder on this computer to get started.

home.summaryProjects.one: You have {count} recent project on this computer.
home.summaryProjects.other: You have {count} recent projects on this computer.

home.recentEmpty: No projects opened yet. Choose any folder with CSV files to start.
home.toolAnnotateDesc: Label text and images (not built yet)
home.diskUsage: This project uses {used} of your {limit} limit.
home.diskWarn: Working space is over 80 percent of your limit. Nothing is deleted automatically.
home.diskOver: Working space is over your limit. Empty recently deleted or raise the limit in Settings.
home.diskNoProject: Open a project to see its working space.
home.trashSummary: {items}, kept until you empty them or {days} pass.
home.recoveredNotice: Restored your last changes after an unexpected stop.
files.title: Files
files.subtitle: {project} · {count} · {size}
files.note: These are your files, as ordinary files. The Hub never changes an original. A tool saves a new file beside it.
files.noProject: Open a project folder to see its files.
files.empty: There are no files at the top of this folder yet.
files.inspectorEmpty: Select a file to see what you can do with it.
files.excelNotSupported: Excel files cannot be opened yet. Save the file as CSV first to open it in Clean.
files.otherNotSupported: This file type cannot be opened in Kola Hub yet.

annotate.subtitle: Not built yet
annotate.heading: Annotate is not built yet
annotate.body: Text and image labelling will arrive in the next phase. For now, use Clean to prepare your CSV tables.
backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Recently deleted, disk space and sealed backups
backup.trashNote: Kept for {days}, then removed when you choose. Change the time in Settings.
backup.trashEmptyState: Nothing in recently deleted for this project.
backup.trashNoProject: Open a project to see its recently deleted files.
backup.restoredAll: Restored all items to the project folder.
backup.diskWarnNote: When a project passes 80 percent of the limit, the Hub warns you. It never deletes anything for you.
backup.createDesc: One sealed file with the projects you pick, for a USB drive or another folder.
backup.noProjectsToBackup: Open at least one project first.
backup.passphraseWarn: Write the passphrase down. If it is lost, nobody can open the backup. The Hub cannot reset it.
backup.passphraseMismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
backup.selectAtLeastOne: Pick at least one project to back up.
backup.testDesc: Read a backup and restore sample files into a scratch folder, so you know it opens before you need it.
backup.testDone: Backup checked: {files} files ({size}), {sampled} sample files verified.
backup.restoreDesc: Pick a sealed backup file and an empty folder to unpack your projects into.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, storage and what the Hub keeps private
settings.labellerDesc: Optional. Used later when two people compare labels. Never uploaded.
settings.limitDesc: The Hub warns you at 80 percent and never deletes anything automatically.
settings.retentionDesc: How long deleted items stay in recently deleted.
settings.privacyBody: Nothing leaves this computer. The Hub has no account, no usage tracking and no cloud. Your files and steps stay in your project folder.
settings.privacyBodyAiOn: Kola Hub itself sends nothing off this computer and has no account, tracking or cloud. Because AI tool access is on, an assistant you connect can read files in projects you have opened in Kola Hub and may send what it reads to its own service.
settings.aiAccessLabel: Let AI tools use my projects
settings.aiAccessDesc: An AI assistant you connect on this computer can read files in projects you have opened in Kola Hub, suggest or run cleaning steps, save new copies, and move files to recently deleted. It cannot change original files, empty recently deleted, make backups, or open other folders, and it sees the contents of any file it reads.
settings.aboutBody: Kola Hub {version}. Open-source offline desktop tools under the Apache-2.0 licence.
clean.title: Clean
clean.subtitleEmpty: Open a CSV file to see what is wrong and fix it step by step
clean.pickHeading: Choose a CSV file to clean
clean.pickEmpty: No CSV files found in this project. Add a CSV file to the project folder or open another folder.
clean.pickNoProject: Open a project folder first to choose a CSV file.
clean.saveHint: Saves a new CSV beside the original. Your original file is never changed.
clean.profileNote: Amber cells are the ones Clean thinks are wrong. Nothing has changed yet. Your original file is not touched.
clean.profileNoteWithSteps: Showing your table after {steps}. Amber cells still look wrong. Your original file is not touched.
clean.issuesEmpty: No problems found in this table.

clean.issuesSub.one: {count} issue found. Fix it below or save a copy.
clean.issuesSub.other: {count} issues found, biggest first. Fix them in any order.

clean.issueExtraSpaces: Spaces at the start or end
clean.fixPreviewNote: Red is removed, green is the new value. Amber cells need a person and are left unchanged.
clean.stepNameTrimAll: Trim extra spaces in all columns
clean.dayFirstLabel: Day comes first (for example 12/11/2026 is 12 November)
clean.spellingSuggestHint: Tick the groups of spellings you want to merge into one.
clean.spellingNone: No near-matching spellings were found in this column.
clean.stepsEmpty: No steps applied yet. Pick a fix above to preview and apply it.
clean.needsPersonNote: Clean left these unchanged rather than guessing. Type a value and save to fix a cell.
clean.needsPersonCapped: Showing the first {shown} entries. {total} rows need a person in total.
clean.reuseDesc: Pick another CSV file in this project that already has saved cleaning steps, then run those steps on {file}.
clean.reuseNoOtherFiles: There are no other CSV files in this project to copy steps from.
clean.reuseNoFilesWithSteps: No other CSV files in this project have saved steps yet. Clean a file first, then come back here to reuse its steps.
clean.reuseStopped: Steps did not run because some needed columns are missing or repeated. Nothing was guessed.
clean.reuseSaveDesc: Save as a new CSV file beside {file}. Excel export is not supported yet.

error.internal: Something went wrong inside Kola Hub. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
error.not-found: That item could not be found.
error.io: A file could not be read or saved. Check that the disk is not full and the folder is not read only.
error.database: The project's saved work could not be updated. Nothing was changed.
error.newer-version: This project or backup was made with a newer version of Kola Hub. Update the app to open it.
error.database-damaged: The saved work in this project is damaged. Your own files are safe and have not been touched.
error.blob-corrupt: A stored copy of a file does not match what was saved, so it was not used.
error.bad-name: That file name cannot be used here.
error.outside-project: That item is outside the open project folder.
error.conflict: A file with that name already exists.
error.passphrase-too-short: The passphrase is too short. Use a longer passphrase.
error.nothing-to-back-up: Pick at least one project to include in the backup.
error.destination-exists: A file already exists at that location. Choose a new file name.
error.folder-not-empty: Choose an empty folder to unpack the backup into.
error.not-a-backup: That file is not a Kola Hub backup.
error.wrong-passphrase-or-damaged: The passphrase did not work, or the backup file is damaged.
error.too-many-open: Too many files are open for cleaning. Close one first.
error.steps-changed-elsewhere: The steps for this file were changed in another window. Nothing was saved. Open the file again to see them.
error.too-long: That value is too long for one cell.
error.blocked: The saved steps cannot run on this file. Change or remove the steps first.
error.steps-too-large: This list of steps is too long. Nothing was changed.
error.repeated-column: More than one column has that name.
error.no-steps: That file has no saved steps to use.
error.backup-inside-project: Save the backup outside your project folders, for example on a USB drive.
error.bad-settings: One of the settings is not a value Kola Hub can use. Nothing was saved.
error.unusable-location: That place cannot be used. Choose a folder on this computer.
